analysis.title: Futuristic Villa Property Showcase
analysis.notes: A dreamy architectural hero image is framed inside a large rounded interface, with translucent blue overlays and warm interior lighting creating strong depth. The surrounding monochrome mountain backdrop and restrained interface controls give the composition an editorial, premium real-estate feel.
analysis.heroPrompt: A cinematic editorial photograph of a futuristic desert villa at blue hour, featuring smooth organic architecture, sweeping tubular terraces, panoramic glass walls, and warm amber interior lighting. Frame the residence in a wide landscape composition with pale blue sky, soft distant mountains, and a quiet sandy foreground. Emphasize rounded forms, reflective glass, atmospheric haze, refined luxury, and a cool blue-to-warm-orange color contrast. Clean architectural photography, premium real-estate art direction, no people, no text, no logos.
